breakdown.description: The prompt forms the strain energy with a constant peak moment, even though the cantilever bending moment under an end load varies along the span.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats the flawed instruction from the incomplete prompt, setting M = P·L as a constant peak value over the full span and forming U = ∫₀ᴸ (P²L²)/(2EI) dx. The ground truth requires using the correct varying bending moment M(x) = P(L - x) along the span. The agent did not fix this inconsistency; it followed the incorrect approach and arrived at δ = PL³/(EI) instead of the correct δ = PL³/(3EI).
